designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.heading: Learning that connects you, connections that teach you
designSystem.intro: This page exists so every component can be seen together, in both themes, in both languages and at every width. It does not ship to production. If something looks bad here, it would look bad in the feed.
designSystem.footer: Phase 1 is closed: tokens, i18n, identity and the base components. Next comes the schema, the seed and the access layer.

colors.intro: A single source of truth. No component writes hex directly.
colors.facultiesNote: A faculty colour follows the student everywhere: on their name, in the channel, in the ranking.

contrast.intro: The audit is computed from the active theme's values, not from a hand-written table. Switch the theme above and the numbers change.

typography.intro: Inter for the interface, Instrument Serif for headlines worth remembering, JetBrains Mono for numbers. A line never passes 68 characters.
typography.sampleBody: Student knowledge today lives in WhatsApp groups and Drive folders. Every year when the cohort changes, that knowledge disappears. Here it stays, and it can be found.
typography.sampleMuted: Microeconomics lecture notes 2024, Prof. Berisha · 84 pages · 312 downloads
typography.measureBody: This is the maximum allowed line length. The eye follows the line without tiring and finds the start of the next one without effort.
typography.measureNoteBody: Without a limit the same paragraph stretches the full screen and becomes unreadable at 1920px. That is why the feed column never passes 720px.

space.intro: A 4px system. Radius grows with the surface. Shadows take the brand colour, never black.
space.motionBody: Content reveals as a fade plus 12px upward, easing cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1). If the system asks for reduced motion, animations turn themselves off.

identity.intro: One component for every place a person appears. The check mark means an institutional email, not Pro.
identity.avatarsNote: with no photo the gradient is generated from the name and never changes

buttons.intro: Five variants. One primary action per screen. The label says what happens.

forms.intro: One decision per screen. Label above the field, help below it, and an error replaces the help while always offering a fix.
forms.interestsNote: they feed social recommendations, never academic ones
forms.switchesNote: changes save themselves, no Save button

landing.hero: Everything you need for university. In one place.
landing.sub: Learning that connects you, connections that teach you. Materials, questions and the people in your year, instead of WhatsApp groups and folders that vanish every year.
landing.cta: Sign in with your student email
landing.valueTitle: What you get in the first 60 seconds
landing.valueBody: Even with no friends yet. Value comes before the network, not after it.
landing.v1b: Pick your courses once. Scripts, past exams and your year's notes come by themselves.
landing.v2b: Lecture notes, summaries and past exams, tied to the course. Not Drive folders that vanish with the cohort.
landing.v3: Ask the people who passed it
landing.v3b: An unanswered question goes to students who already took that exam. That is how the years connect.
landing.v4: An assistant that knows your courses
landing.v4b: It explains, summarises and builds quizzes from your faculty's materials, always citing the source.
landing.proBody: Your own faculty's materials, questions, messages and uploading stay free forever. Pro opens the other faculties and universities. And whoever contributes gets it free.
landing.proPoint1: One approved material gives you 7 days of Pro.
landing.proPoint2: One accepted answer gives you a day.
landing.proPoint3: Ten materials in a month give you the whole semester.
landing.facultiesBody: Every faculty has its own colour, its own channels and its own library.
landing.stepsTitle: Three steps and you are in
landing.s2b: They are pre-selected from your programme.
landing.s3b: Twelve profiles ranked by real closeness.
landing.closingTitle: Your notes will be read long after you
landing.closingBody: If you keep good notes, here they do not disappear when the semester ends. And your name stays on them.
landing.demoCta: See how it looks, without an account
landing.footerLegal: This platform follows Law No. 06/L-082 on Personal Data Protection. The minimum age is 16.

signup.codeWait: Wait a moment before we send it again.
signup.codeMailFailed: The email couldn't be sent. Try again in a minute.
signup.codeWrong: That code isn't right. Check the email again.
signup.codeTooMany: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
signup.codeExpired: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
signup.alreadyConfirmed: Your student email is already confirmed.
signup.idLead: Take a photo of the front of your student card. Our team checks it and opens your account, usually within a day.
signup.idRejectedBody: Take a new photo with the whole card readable.
signup.idNotImage: Pick a photo, not another kind of file.
signup.idFrameHint: Your name, photo and institution need to be readable.
signup.idTip1: The whole card in the photo, no fingers over it.
signup.idTip2: Good light, no glare on the plastic.
signup.idTip3: The name on the card matches your account.
signup.idMissing: Upload your ID photo before sending.
signup.idSent: Photo sent. Now finish your profile.
signup.idPrivacy: The photo stays private: only the verification team sees it, and it's deleted as soon as they decide.

review.toastPending: Your account is being reviewed. Once the team approves your ID, you can post, comment and message.
review.toastMissing: Send a photo of your student ID to open your account.
review.toastRejected: Your ID photo wasn't accepted. Send a new one to open your account.
review.pendingBody: Until the team approves your ID, you can only look around: no posts, comments, likes, stories or messages. Usually within a day.
review.missingBody: Send a photo of your student card to open your account.
review.rejectedBody: See the reason and send a new photo.

password.title: Change password
password.body: Enter your current password, then the new one twice.
password.forgot: Can’t remember it? Reset it with Google
password.changed: Password changed. Next time you log in with the new one.
password.errorRules: The new password needs 8+ characters, three of the four rules, and has to match the repeat.
password.errorSame: The new password has to be different from the current one.
password.errorNoPassword: This account has no password yet. Set one via “Forgot your password?”.
